title: PragerU Video: Why a Journalist is Suing Dearborn, Michigan
text:
Order Jamie Glazov’s new book, ‘United in Hate: The Left’s Romance with Tyranny, Terror, and Hamas’ : HERE .
In this new episode of The Brief: Insights From The Inside , Shabbos Kestenbaum sits down with Margot Cleveland, senior legal correspondent for The Federalist and counsel for the New Civil Liberties Alliance, to discuss her federal civil-rights lawsuit against the City of Dearborn and Mayor Abdullah Hammoud. The case involves taxpayer money going to celebrate Ramadan while ignoring repeated requests for recognition of Easter, Passover, and other Christian and Jewish holidays.
Don’t miss this interview about a groundbreaking case.
